context: Tests whether the skill causes the agent to provide production-ready Docker Compose configuration for OpenTelemetry Collector. Docker Compose configurations should include proper networking, health checks, volume management, and are often used in development and simple production setups.

checklist.name: Includes collector and sample application services
checklist.description: The docker-compose.yml defines at least two services: the collector and an application that sends telemetry to it. Score zero if only the collector is defined.

checklist.name: Uses custom network for service discovery
checklist.description: Services are connected via a custom bridge network (not the default network) to enable DNS-based service discovery. Apps should reference collector by service name (e.g., 'otel-collector') not localhost.

checklist.name: Mounts collector configuration file
checklist.description: The collector service includes a volume mount for the configuration file (e.g., './otel-collector-config.yaml:/etc/otel-collector-config.yaml'). Score zero if config is not mounted.

checklist.name: Includes health checks for both services
checklist.description: Both collector and application containers include healthcheck directives to enable Docker monitoring. Health checks should verify service availability (e.g., HTTP endpoint for collector, open port for app).

checklist.name: Exposes collector ports appropriately
checklist.description: The collector service exposes necessary ports: receiver ports (e.g., 4317 for gRPC OTLP) should NOT be exposed externally (only within network), while exporter targets are configured for backend communication.

checklist.name: Includes environment variables for configuration
checklist.description: Services use environment variables for configuration (e.g., OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, backend credentials). Secrets should not be hardcoded in the compose file.
